(ii) Measure dissolved O2 in one sample immediately; keep a second identical sample sealed in the dark (≈20 °C) for 5 days, then measure its dissolved O2. BOD = the decrease in dissolved oxygen (converted to mg dm−3).

(iii) Little organic matter/few microorganisms consuming oxygen — the water is relatively clean/unpolluted.
